experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4633:./reassess/r_3.md:7891:./reassess/r_3.md:3309:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_7.md:8446:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp330_compositional_dro/design.md:33:- **前置 GAP 检查（先跑 ERM）**：ERM 自己 held-out mean mAP 是否显著 < seen mean（存在组合 GAP）。若 ERM 无 GAP（held≈seen）→ 无 occluder-class 捷径可利用 → 整 bet NO-GO（合理早 kill，省 DRO）。有 GAP 才看 DRO 能否合上。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4634:./reassess/r_3.md:7897:./reassess/r_3.md:3334:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4635:./reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4636:./reassess/r_3.md:7906:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4637:./reassess/r_3.md:7933:./reassess/r_3.md:3910:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_8.md:312:审查只拦实质问题：代码正确性的错误、数据泄漏、评测协议前后不一致、变量没隔离干净、比较不公平。操作上、文档上的小问题，可以记成待办，但不要拦。结论写进 `experiments/expNNN/review-codex.md`。通过时要明确写“无实质问题”“approve”“审查通过”或“放行”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4640:./reassess/r_3.md:7953:./reassess/r_3.md:4096:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:4:代码层面我没看到 AIRL eval/fuse 的关键实现错误，也没看到 FUSE 使用 query/gallery label 的泄漏。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4641:./reassess/r_3.md:7954:./reassess/r_3.md:4097:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:10:  训练中用 query/gallery eval 结果保存 `model_best`，若论文报告 best 而不是 final，会构成 test-set model selection 泄漏。当前 AG-ReID.v2 4090 主日志 best=final epoch60，所以这次主数未被实际污染。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4642:./reassess/r_3.md:7955:./reassess/r_3.md:4098:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:42:- 主要风险不是代码泄漏，而是实验口径：不要报告 test-best；AG-ReID.v2 当前只能 claim “融合互补”，不能 claim “净超 baseline”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4643:./reassess/r_3.md:7956:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4644:./reassess/r_3.md:7957:./reassess/r_3.md:4100:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:155:代码主路径基本可信，尤其 `iso_trunk_recce=0 / rec_only=True` 的梯度隔离没有看到实质性泄漏。但结果解释需要收紧：AG-ReID.v2 final 日志不支持“net gain ≈ +1.5 / 等于融合增益”，部分文档还把 ep50 当成 final，且 seed2 / 3090 AIRL 日志不完整。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4645:./reassess/r_3.md:7958:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4891:./reassess/r_3.md:11148:reviews/deep_19.md:625:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:64:- **事实**: 我已用 `importlib.util.find_spec` 实测：以 `python3 afd_train.py` 在 `cargo_cvpb/` 运行时，主脚本是 `__main__`，`import afd_train` 命中 `afd_reid/afd_train.py`(✓ 文档命令正确)。**但**这依赖"脚本运行"这一前提：若有人 `cd` 到别处用绝对路径跑、或把本文件当模块 `import`，`sys.path` 顺序可能变，`import afd_train` 有撞回自身的风险(循环 import)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3655:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:1:# 实验 CVPB: CARGO 航拍-地面 跨视角原型桥接 + 局部证据匹配
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3656:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:3:> 战略重思后选定(5 死角后, 3 codex strat 强收敛)。★★方法论转向: **放弃"验证 confound 是真依赖"(杀光一切), 改 empirical 涨点导向**——在 CARGO baseline 上试 +module 能否 beat = 真 kill-switch。这是 167 篇库真实配方(命名 gap + 2 模块 + 多数据集 SOTA 表 + framing)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/design.md:6:- CARGO 航拍-地面 baseline(resnet50 BoT)mean A↔G mAP **32.48%**, VDT SOTA ~50% → **大 headroom**。AGPReID 活赛道(VDT CVPR24 / SeCap CVPR25 / GSAlign NeurIPS25 / ViSA CVPR26), 范式都是"命名视角/几何/语义 gap + 2 模块 + CARGO/AG-ReID 表", **不证 confound 依赖**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3674:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:12:OVP-Mem 的工程实现是**正确且不会崩**的：无 NaN/inf 路径、梯度隔离干净(bank 是 buffer 不回传)、dtype 一致、`--ovp` off 精确复现 baseline。kill-switch #1(maxsim probe)已 PASS(+0.86)且 pipeline 复现 32.48 准确。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3677:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:32:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` `OVPMemory.loss` L124-148；冷启动门控 L130-139；`tau` 默认 L190。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3678:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:34:- **后果**: 第 1(几)个 epoch OVP 实际不产生有效监督，但 `meters['ovp']`(L292/301)打印接近 0，**会被误读为"已收敛"**；kill-switch #2 的"ep10 ≥+1.0"判读因此失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3679:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:37:  a. 给 `ovp_lambda` 或 `tau` 加 **warmup**(例如前 N 个 epoch λ=0 只填 bank、或 tau 从 0.2 退火到 0.05)，避开随机原型尖峰；
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3680:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:45:- **位置**: `afd_train.py` L272 注释 + L273-274；`ovp.loss` 内 L141 `z @ protos.t()`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3681:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:46:- **事实**: `ovp.loss(...)` 整个调用在 `with torch.amp.autocast('cuda')`(L260)**上下文内**。`torch.matmul/mm` 在 autocast fp16 op 列表上，即便 `z=F.normalize(bn.float())` 是 fp32，matmul 仍可能被 autocast 降为 fp16。`cross_entropy` 在 fp32 列表上会被升回 fp32，所以 softmax 安全。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3682:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:62:- **事实**: 我已用 `importlib.util.find_spec` 实测：以 `python3 afd_train.py` 在 `cargo_cvpb/` 运行时，主脚本是 `__main__`，`import afd_train` 命中 `afd_reid/afd_train.py`(✓ 文档命令正确)。**但**这依赖"脚本运行"这一前提：若有人 `cd` 到别处用绝对路径跑、或把本文件当模块 `import`，`sys.path` 顺序可能变，`import afd_train` 有撞回自身的风险(循环 import)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:63:- **建议**: 低成本加固——把导入改成显式包名(如建个 `__init__.py` 或用 `importlib` 按文件路径加载)，或在 README/run 命令处明确"必须 `cd cargo_cvpb && python3 afd_train.py`"。**当前文档命令安全**，故仅 Medium。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3684:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:68:  - **CMPC(CVPR22)**：per-cluster per-modality 原型 + momentum + InfoNCE 把实例拉向**对侧模态**同身份原型、推开其它——与 OVP-Mem loss 近乎逐字同构。差异仅 voice-face↔aerial-ground、无监督↔有监督。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3685:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:69:  - **MBCE(AAAI23, VI-ReID)**：modality-aware centroid proxies + momentum memory + cross-modality 对齐——同构，且已在 person ReID 发表。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3687:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:73:- **要求**: 这是 empirical 探索，跑可以；但**进方法稿前**(design.md L19 的"≥35-36→进方法稿")必须把 OVP-Mem **降级为 auxiliary loss**，真正的 novelty 由别处承担（子代理建议看 Module-2 non-correspondence local set-matching，撞车面更小）。**否则违反 CLAUDE.md 创新门槛 + "不在旧 branch 堆小模块"**。建议在 design.md 显式记一句"OVP-Mem 已知与 CMPC/MBCE/PDPA 高度重叠，仅作 empirical 组件，不作 headline"。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1819:reassess/r_3.md:4015:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2696:挂团队资产：SMPL 3D 几何、SOLIDER-Swin、pose 热图门控。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1821:reassess/r_3.md:4017:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2700:cheap kill-switch：先做训练很轻的辅助头。冻结或半冻结 SOLIDER，在现有数据上预测 SMPL joint visibility、身体表面区域或姿态几何 token，看辅助监督是否能改善跨视角检索。若只学几何 token 不改善，说明几何语义没有进入身份判别，及时停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1823:reassess/r_3.md:4019:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2742:挂团队资产：SMPL 3D 几何、aerial-ground、SOLIDER-Swin。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1824:reassess/r_3.md:4020:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2744:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1825:reassess/r_3.md:4021:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2746:cheap kill-switch：先不训练。用现有 SMPL 或 2D pose 估计，把图像切成可见身体区域，测试 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上“几何可比区域相似度”是否比全局 SOLIDER 相似度更能区分正负样本。若同身份跨视角失败样本主要集中在低可见表面重叠区域，并且简单几何重加权能带来超过噪声线的提升，再立项。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1826:reassess/r_3.md:4023:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2756:cheap kill-switch：冻结 SOLIDER，用 pose heatmap 置信度或 SMPL 可见性做零训练 token reweighting。看航拍 query 对地面 gallery 的错误检索是否被低置信区域主导。若只用高置信身体区域能稳定改善，说明“区域可靠性”是真问题。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4153:reassess/r_2.md:993:reassess/r_3.md:1951:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4155:reassess/r_2.md:995:reassess/r_3.md:1953:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:18:ROLES[2]="角色=**全新方向探子**。彻底放下SMPL/遮挡/航拍-地面三个失败区(不准碰)。团队只剩: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone(可冻结当强特征源) + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO数据 + 22招式 + 读过167篇。用联网+招式提**1-2个真正新的B类方向**: 新问题定义或新观察(不是新模块), 每个带触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/**廉价(最好零训练)kill-switch**/撞车核查。优先'用强backbone冻结特征就能验隐藏变量'的方向(像我们之前那种零训练kill-switch)。务实中文。"

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4202:reassess/r_2.md:1158:reassess/r_3.md:2382:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/novelty_gopl.txt:12:| (e) SMPL / 3D-geometry-guided ReID | 存活但不能大喊 first | [OG-Net / 3D Space ReID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569) 已把 2D 图像映射到 3D point cloud / visible surface 上学习 ReID 表征；[GCL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.09071) 用 HMR mesh rotation 生成新视角并做 contrastive；[CASE-Net / SMPL-reID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.07340) 用 SMPL 合成数据研究换衣/shape。 | 已有人用 SMPL/mesh/3D 做 ReID 表征、生成、合成数据。GOPL 的切口是：**SMPL 只作 pair-reliability meter，不作 identity feature、不作 alignment、不作 augmentation**。这个切口目前没看到确切先例。 | 8/10 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4203:reassess/r_2.md:1159:reassess/r_3.md:2383:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/novelty_gopl.txt:13:| (f) graph-sampler / relation ReID | 存活 | [SGGNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.09975) 建 probe-gallery relation graph；[GCT](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.00242) 用 graph matching 做 correspondence transfer；[PVPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230) 也用 graph matching；[CLIP-DFGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11255) 用 graph sampler 做 hard sample mining。 | graph / sampler / relation 都不新。GOPL 要强调 graph 的边权来自 **SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap**，且图服务于 same-ID positive learning order，而不是检索时关系推理。 | 7/10 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4239:reassess/r_2.md:1255:reassess/r_3.md:2797:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:185:./pivot/p_3.md:1864:写零训练 kill-switch 脚本(复用 error_analysis_geom.py 基建: frozen Swin 提 μ + σ, CARGO A↔G, 8 破坏对照 + SMPL 分桶)。GPU: lab-3090(CARGO + swin_fix256 ckpt 在)。先双审? —— 这是零训练诊断脚本不是训练, 但仍走 codex 审一遍脚本正确性再跑。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4240:reassess/r_2.md:1257:reassess/r_3.md:2799:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:193:./pivot/p_2.md:26:角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4241:reassess/r_2.md:1262:reassess/r_3.md:2821:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:653:./analyses/deep_25.txt:33:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义里长出来的。先在 SMPL mesh 上预训练 vertex embeddings，让嵌入距离对应 geodesic distance 和 tangent direction；再用 3D mesh recovery 和相机参数把顶点、采样表面点投影到 2D 图像，训练 U-Net 输出 pixel-level dense correspondence embeddings；视频帧串起来就是 3D gait field。然后用 local similarity learning 建模局部时空邻域，最后用 MRIE 的全局和局部代表 token 让 gait 和 appearance 高效交互。这里不是随便拼模块，主线是“稀疏 3D 先验变成稠密、时空对齐、可融合的 ReID 表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4242:reassess/r_2.md:1264:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4277:reassess/r_2.md:1504:reassess/r_3.md:3291:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_3.md:3582:我最看好的顺序是 1、3、2、4。第一条问题层面最强，能把航拍地面的“极端视角”讲成因果混杂，而不是普通跨域。第三条最容易首验，成本低。第二条依赖 SMPL 质量，但一旦成立，机制会比二维姿态门控更硬。第四条成本最高，适合作为前面方向有信号后的数据增强证据，不建议单独当主线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4278:reassess/r_2.md:1505:reassess/r_3.md:3294:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4279:reassess/r_2.md:1506:reassess/r_3.md:3295:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4280:reassess/r_2.md:1507:reassess/r_3.md:3296:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:23:角色=**残酷判官**。不留情面: 连续2个cheap-kill负 + SMPL反复证伪 + 三大资产全弱, 这个团队到底**还有没有**能发B类方法稿的真路? 还是诚实答案='手里的empirical资产出不了干净B类method, 该换问题域/换数据/换打法'? 联网核查ReID 2024-2026 method空间。**别和稀泥**: 要么明确指1条最可能成的(带理由+廉价kill-switch), 要么明确说'没有, 该转去X'(X具体)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4284:reassess/r_2.md:1521:reassess/r_3.md:3334:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5021:reassess/r_3.md:2757:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:4346:   615	gallery images do not overlap with the training set.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5022:reassess/r_3.md:2759:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6450:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报最终涨点，而是分别证明 DMM 和 CDCN 的角色。消融显示 DMM 提升抗遗忘但会牺牲适应性，CDCN 提升适应性并改善记忆，二者组合互相补偿。另一个关键证据是 DMM 只放在重放阶段最好，放在适应阶段会污染相机认知节点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5023:reassess/r_3.md:2762:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6484:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果注意力会看错，就用 HRNet 解析出人体前景 mask，把 mask patch 投影成语义嵌入，和图像 patch、位置、相机嵌入一起送入 Transformer。若高层 patch 太平滑，就聚合第 2、4、10、12 层的 patch 表征做 HFA。若遮挡导致全局特征断裂，就用多分支空洞卷积 DFC 补全不同感受野下的全局信息。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5042:reassess/r_3.md:2821:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:653:./analyses/deep_25.txt:33:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义里长出来的。先在 SMPL mesh 上预训练 vertex embeddings，让嵌入距离对应 geodesic distance 和 tangent direction；再用 3D mesh recovery 和相机参数把顶点、采样表面点投影到 2D 图像，训练 U-Net 输出 pixel-level dense correspondence embeddings；视频帧串起来就是 3D gait field。然后用 local similarity learning 建模局部时空邻域，最后用 MRIE 的全局和局部代表 token 让 gait 和 appearance 高效交互。这里不是随便拼模块，主线是“稀疏 3D 先验变成稠密、时空对齐、可融合的 ReID 表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5043:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5044:reassess/r_3.md:2835:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:729:./analyses/deep_21.txt:59:4. **证据闭环**：最关键消融是 VARA、SAM、SMCF 分开加。VARA 证明中间层抑制有效，SAM 证明骨架区域比点热图更完整。进一步分析 VARA 插入位置，发现中层最好，这正好支撑“输出层太晚、低层语义不够、高层分辨率太低”的重定义。SAM 的 α、γ、T 可视化和不同遮挡程度可视化，也在证明骨架区域建模确实覆盖可见身体而抑制遮挡。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5045:reassess/r_3.md:2843:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:819:./B_CONTAINMENT_DESIGN.md:66:写零训练 kill-switch 脚本(复用 error_analysis_geom.py 基建: frozen Swin 提 μ + σ, CARGO A↔G, 8 破坏对照 + SMPL 分桶)。GPU: lab-3090(CARGO + swin_fix256 ckpt 在)。先双审? —— 这是零训练诊断脚本不是训练, 但仍走 codex 审一遍脚本正确性再跑。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5046:reassess/r_3.md:2857:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:854:./analyses/deep_16.txt:9:5. reviewer 为什么买账：更买机制完整性和遮挡场景表现，不完全是视角。真正 novelty 来自“用动态原型掩码加姿态聚合做可见部位匹配”的组合，而不是单个模块。对我们有用的教训是，遮挡论文如果只是“加部位模块”，必须有强可视化和分模块消融支撑，否则视角不够硬。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5047:reassess/r_3.md:2858:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5051:reassess/r_3.md:2873:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1011:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:441:5. reviewer 为什么买账：更买机制完整性和遮挡场景表现，不完全是视角。真正 novelty 来自“用动态原型掩码加姿态聚合做可见部位匹配”的组合，而不是单个模块。对我们有用的教训是，遮挡论文如果只是“加部位模块”，必须有强可视化和分模块消融支撑，否则视角不够硬。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5053:reassess/r_3.md:2880:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1026:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:911:4. **证据闭环**：最关键消融是 VARA、SAM、SMCF 分开加。VARA 证明中间层抑制有效，SAM 证明骨架区域比点热图更完整。进一步分析 VARA 插入位置，发现中层最好，这正好支撑“输出层太晚、低层语义不够、高层分辨率太低”的重定义。SAM 的 α、γ、T 可视化和不同遮挡程度可视化，也在证明骨架区域建模确实覆盖可见身体而抑制遮挡。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5054:reassess/r_3.md:2884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1038:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1150:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义里长出来的。先在 SMPL mesh 上预训练 vertex embeddings，让嵌入距离对应 geodesic distance 和 tangent direction；再用 3D mesh recovery 和相机参数把顶点、采样表面点投影到 2D 图像，训练 U-Net 输出 pixel-level dense correspondence embeddings；视频帧串起来就是 3D gait field。然后用 local similarity learning 建模局部时空邻域，最后用 MRIE 的全局和局部代表 token 让 gait 和 appearance 高效交互。这里不是随便拼模块，主线是“稀疏 3D 先验变成稠密、时空对齐、可融合的 ReID 表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5055:reassess/r_3.md:2886:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1040:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1154:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5079:reassess/r_3.md:3040:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5201:reassess/r_3.md:3596:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:437:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5209:reassess/r_3.md:3614:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3474:区别：最像 APD，但 APD 在潜空间里做度量扰动，物理含义弱。我们把困难样本定义成 SMPL 相机、可见面、投影尺度改变后产生的“同人不像、异人很像”的物理困难样本。也不同于扩散增广论文，因为第一版可以只做 mask/token 级视角扰动，不碰高成本图像生成。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5210:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5211:reassess/r_3.md:3617:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3482:我建议优先压第 1 和第 2。第 1 的问题定义最清楚，和团队的 pose gating、SMPL、aerial-ground 都能挂上；第 2 的论文叙事更像 Pattern Recognition/TMM，能把“不要过度对齐”讲成机制。第 3 可以作为训练机制配套，第 4 更像无监督扩展，除非 cheap kill-switch 很强，否则不要先押。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5228:reassess/r_3.md:3660:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:454:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5250:reassess/r_3.md:3740:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3164:区别：最像 DMPF 和 DMIC，但它们处理的是 VI-ReID 的模态、姿态、相机差异。我们切的是航拍到地面的 3D 投影差异，同一个人体部位在图像中尺度、可见性和形变全部变了。机制可以是把 2D token 投到 SMPL canonical body surface，再在 canonical 空间做身份表示，view-specific residual 单独建模。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5251:reassess/r_3.md:3741:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3165:cheap kill-switch：不用训练新模型，先在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上用现有 SMPL/pose 估计，把 SOLIDER token 按身体区域重聚合，比较原始全局特征和 canonical part 特征的跨视角同 ID 相似度。如果同 ID 排名或正负间隔没有明显改善，这条先停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5252:reassess/r_3.md:3743:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5253:reassess/r_3.md:3746:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3175:cheap kill-switch：在现有顺序数据上做一个轻量探针，比较普通 SOLIDER 特征和 SMPL 分区后的特征在旧域遗忘样本上的互补性。如果 SMPL 分区特征不能挽回旧域近邻，或者和原特征高度冗余，这条不押。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5254:reassess/r_3.md:3749:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3180:cheap kill-switch：先做零训练分析，按估计视角高度或 SMPL 投影误差分桶，看跨域检索错误是否随这些物理量单调变化。没有单调关系，就说明物理视角约束不是主因，别硬做。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5255:reassess/r_3.md:3752:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3242:区别：最像 DMPF 和 DMIC，但它们处理的是 VI-ReID 的模态、姿态、相机差异。我们切的是航拍到地面的 3D 投影差异，同一个人体部位在图像中尺度、可见性和形变全部变了。机制可以是把 2D token 投到 SMPL canonical body surface，再在 canonical 空间做身份表示，view-specific residual 单独建模。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5256:reassess/r_3.md:3753:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3243:cheap kill-switch：不用训练新模型，先在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上用现有 SMPL/pose 估计，把 SOLIDER token 按身体区域重聚合，比较原始全局特征和 canonical part 特征的跨视角同 ID 相似度。如果同 ID 排名或正负间隔没有明显改善，这条先停。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5257:reassess/r_3.md:3755:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3247:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5258:reassess/r_3.md:3758:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3253:cheap kill-switch：在现有顺序数据上做一个轻量探针，比较普通 SOLIDER 特征和 SMPL 分区后的特征在旧域遗忘样本上的互补性。如果 SMPL 分区特征不能挽回旧域近邻，或者和原特征高度冗余，这条不押。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5259:reassess/r_3.md:3761:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3258:cheap kill-switch：先做零训练分析，按估计视角高度或 SMPL 投影误差分桶，看跨域检索错误是否随这些物理量单调变化。没有单调关系，就说明物理视角约束不是主因，别硬做。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5262:reassess/r_3.md:3769:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_18.md:560:正在做: 起多路 codex 先例优先搜下一方向(明确禁用鲁棒性/不变性/去偏/线索手术死簇),我用 WebSearch 逐个核实先例。资产复用: PRCC/LTCC/Market 标准 ViT-base 基线 + 三个零训练探针(指纹/oracle/冻结选择器)在 lab-4090/hyy。三机当前空闲(探针类零训练已完成),搜出方向+探针过线再占 GPU。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5265:reassess/r_3.md:3774:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_18.md:610:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5267:reassess/r_3.md:3785:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_18.md:686:- **exp017 探针放行候选 A**：SOLIDER 特征对 CLIP 遮挡物语义零线性解码（R²=-0.01）、嵌入级超锥零假设解释力仅约 26%、残差与 AP 相关 -0.164（控 s_top1 后 -0.097 贴线）。按预注册中间地带规则的属性级判据放行。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5268:reassess/r_3.md:3788:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_18.md:702:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5312:reassess/r_3.md:3933:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_8.md:734:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5334:reassess/r_3.md:4010:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2670:cheap kill-switch：先不训练。用现有 SMPL 或 2D pose 估计，把图像切成可见身体区域，测试 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上“几何可比区域相似度”是否比全局 SOLIDER 相似度更能区分正负样本。若同身份跨视角失败样本主要集中在低可见表面重叠区域，并且简单几何重加权能带来超过噪声线的提升，再立项。

AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5396:reassess/r_3.md:4332:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_5.md:10166:../../decisions.md:4529:**决策**：(1) 不在 decorr 上继续调 λ 找正收益（机制正交，调参无意义，CLAUDE.md 铁律）；(2) **跑 λ=2 + λ=0/λ=1 e30 matched** 把 sweep 做 bulletproof（确认更强 λ/收敛点仍不动），仅用空闲 GPU、不额外烧；(3) FM-import 方法方向**正式关闭**，夜间真产出 = 诊断研究(张力洞察 + 显式干预对照 + ×4 finding + capacity-control + 可复用 oracle 工具)；(4) 真 method 只能走问题 reframe（CLAUDE.md 钦定方向，多日线，醒后与用户定）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5754:reassess/r_3.md:7732:./reassess/r_3.md:1950:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:10:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5755:reassess/r_3.md:7733:./reassess/r_3.md:1951:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5756:reassess/r_3.md:7734:./reassess/r_3.md:1954:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5757:reassess/r_3.md:7768:./reassess/r_3.md:2215:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2011:## ★★★ 最强收敛发现:同框"入侵身份泄漏"(co-present identity leakage)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5758:reassess/r_3.md:7770:./reassess/r_3.md:2218:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5759:reassess/r_3.md:7775:./reassess/r_3.md:2223:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2023:- **★廉价 kill-switch(一晚)**: 合成人遮挡上, 用强 baseline(Swin-Small)embedding 训入侵者-ID 探针。≈随机→强主干已抑制无泄漏可挖→kill; >>随机→有故事。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5760:reassess/r_3.md:7776:./reassess/r_3.md:2224:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5761:reassess/r_3.md:7780:./reassess/r_3.md:2231:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5762:reassess/r_3.md:7781:./reassess/r_3.md:2237:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2120:3. **SMPL 数据/提取=症结**：单图低分辨率遮挡 crop 上 ROMP 的 10-d 体型 β 被相机/姿态噪声主导、与细粒度身份无关 + 主动稀释外观。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5763:reassess/r_3.md:7783:./reassess/r_3.md:2242:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2183:- 遮挡方向不能再讲“缺失补全”，要重定义为：遮挡不是少信息，而是**别人的身份信息污染 target embedding**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5764:reassess/r_3.md:7784:./reassess/r_3.md:2243:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2184:- 这能自然长出方法：训练期合成已知 donor identity 的人遮挡、压制 donor-ID 可预测性、保持 target identity 一致；推理期不加任何外部输入。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5765:reassess/r_3.md:7785:./reassess/r_3.md:2244:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5769:reassess/r_3.md:7796:./reassess/r_3.md:2296:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7635:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5770:reassess/r_3.md:7797:./reassess/r_3.md:2297:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7636:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5771:reassess/r_3.md:7798:./reassess/r_3.md:2298:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7637:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5785:reassess/r_3.md:7872:./reassess/r_3.md:3040:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5789:reassess/r_3.md:7887:./reassess/r_3.md:3294:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5790:reassess/r_3.md:7888:./reassess/r_3.md:3295:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5795:reassess/r_3.md:7897:./reassess/r_3.md:3334:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5796:reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5797:reassess/r_3.md:7906:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5800:reassess/r_3.md:7909:./reassess/r_3.md:3426:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2780:创新类型是新数据设定加新机制。它定义 occluded VI-ReID，指出遮挡和跨模态会叠加造成空间错位和模态退化，并构造 Occluded-SYSU、Occluded-RegDB。能发靠新设定和补全机制双支撑。story 是：遮挡 ReID 不应只看可见区域，而要利用单模态上下文和跨模态互补信息补全缺失身份线索。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5814:reassess/r_3.md:7966:./reassess/r_3.md:4148:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:1:# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:96:6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:4:No Critical runtime/shape/device bug found, but I would not launch this as-is because two training-design issues can invalidate exp359.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:11:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:12:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

# 实验 exp359: LM-ReID (Lattice-Marginalized ReID)

> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。

## 动机

低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

### 零训练 kill-switch 证据（GO）
frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：

| h | rank-1 flip% | single LR | lat-MaxSim | **LATgain** | **LAT−TTA** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | 74.9% | 42.65 | 46.87 | **+4.23** | **+3.04** |
| 24 | 31.3% | 69.31 | 72.98 | **+3.67** | **+2.68** |
| 32 | 9.7% | 81.93 | 83.98 | +2.05 | +1.44 |
| 48 | 1.2% | 90.44 | 91.02 | +0.58 | +0.41 |

两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。

### 诚实 caveat（写法要求）
phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。

## 核心假设

训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。

## 技术方案

### 数据流
1. 正常 ReID baseline（Market，exp260b 同配置）。
2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
3. h 混合训练 h ∈ {16,24,32}，severe-biased（但不只训 h=16）。

### LM-ReID loss
```
z^l = norm(fθ(T_l(x)));  p^l = softmax(W z^l);  z^μ = norm(mean_l z^l);  p^μ = mean_l p^l
L_id   = mean_l [ CE(p^l, y) + Triplet(z^l, y) ]
L_marg = -log[ mean_l p^l[y] ] + Triplet(z^μ, y)                 # marginal likelihood（主贡献）
L_cons = mean_l (1 - cos(z^l, sg(z^μ))) + β·mean_l KL(p^l || sg(p^μ))  # consistency to mean
L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
L = L_id + λ_m·L_marg + λ_c·L_cons + λ_a·L_adv
```
默认 λ_m=1.0, λ_c=0.2, β=0.5, λ_a=0.02–0.05（warmup 后开）。**L_adv 弱辅助非主贡献**（太强会擦身份边缘细节，必须 ablation）。

### 推理 K-marginalization
```
s(q, g) = τ·log[ 1/K Σ_l exp( cos(f(T_l(q)), f(g)) / τ ) ]
```
τ→0 接近 lat-MaxSim（主推，因 lat-MaxSim 46.9 > mean），τ 大接近 mean（消融）。

## 预期结果

**过线（决定 method vs trick）**：
- h=16：训练版 > frozen ensemble **+0.8~2.0 mAP**；> single +5~7；> TTA +2~3.5。
- h=24：稳定收益。
- h=32：允许 marginal 不负。

失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。

## 对照组

- single LR（canonical bicubic，固定一个）。
- 普通 K-TTA（同 K，random crop/flip/color/resize）。
- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
- （成稿）k-reciprocal / SR-based / VPFA。

消融：marg only / marg+cons / marg+cons+adv；τ sweep；K=1/3/5/9 曲线；phase-only vs +bbox+kernel。

## 协议 / benchmark

- 合成：Market/MSMT，gallery HR，query LR h=16/24/32，canonical LR single baseline，K=9（3×3 phase 主，bbox/kernel ablation，不无限扩 K）。所有 TTA 对照 **K-matched**。
- 标准 CR-ReID（成稿补）：MLR-Market / MLR-CUHK03 / CAVIAR（PS-HRNet 用过）。
- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。

## 撞车边界（novelty，codex 5 路联网）

- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。

## 风险与定位

operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

## 审查 / 训练协议

1. 本 design.md（已写）。
2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
3. Claude 广审（Opus 子代理）→ `claude_review.md`；Codex 审（`codex --search exec`）→ `codex_review.md`。**两层通过才训练**。
4. smoke（几 iter 确认各 loss 分量下降无泄漏）。
5. 训练（lab-3090，Market，h 混合，BS=64 不改，TEST.IMS_PER_BATCH 64，PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 nohup）。
6. eval（**test.py 不用 train.py**）：LM-ReID(K marg) vs single / TTA / frozen-ensemble，h=16/24/32 分报，LEG/LOTG/PRF。

**Verdict: needs-attention**

No Critical runtime/shape/device bug found, but I would not launch this as-is because two training-design issues can invalidate exp359.

**Findings**

- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
  Fix: include epoch/worker/call randomness, e.g. dataset `set_epoch(ep)` plus `seed ^ epoch ^ idx`, or use worker-seeded `np.random`/`torch.initial_seed()` so variants change per iteration while remaining reproducible.

- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:48), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:118): default `M=2` plus `mode = j % 3` trains only canonical + bbox-shift/bilinear. It does not train sub-pixel phase or zoom/antialias axes despite the method claim.
  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.

- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. With `0.02-0.05`, the adversarial signal becomes `λ²`.
  Fix: either `GradReverse.apply(z, 1.0)` and keep `adv_lamb * L_adv`, or keep GRL lambda and add unweighted `L_adv`.

- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
  Fix if strict design matters: reshape first and average `batch_hard_triplet(gf_bm[:, m], y, margin)` over `m`.

- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
  Fix: move shared degradation functions into one imported helper, or add a hash/regression test comparing generated PIL bytes for fixed seed.

**Checks That Look Correct**

- `pose_dict=None` path is correct. `PoseBackboneModel.forward` returns `(cls_score, global_feat, featmaps, None)` at [pose_backbone_model.py:1088](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/model/pose_backbone_model.py:1088). Pose/LGPA/GCN branches are skipped because `scene_heatmaps is None`; `_lgpa_fixed_bands` default is `False`.
- AMP is basically safe: autocast wraps only model forward; `cls/gf.float()` makes loss fp32; `GradScaler.scale/step/update` is used.
- Image-major layout is aligned: `xb.view(B*M, ...)`, `y.repeat_interleave(M)`, `view(B,M,...)`, and `arange(M).repeat(B)` all match `[i*M+m]`.
- `batch_hard_triplet` masks are correct under default PK sampling.
- `PKSampler` default gives positives and negatives (`P=16,Kins=4`).
- `torch.save(model.state_dict())` is compatible with SOLIDER `load_param`, which copies matching keys and ignores failures.

**Web Search**

I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

   440	        sims = f_lat @ gf.T                          # [Nq,K,Ng]  (~1.9GB f32)
   441	        part = np.argpartition(-sims, kth=10, axis=2)[:, :, :10]      # top-10 unordered
   442	        rows = np.arange(Nq)[:, None, None]; kk = np.arange(cli.K)[None, :, None]
   443	        ord10 = np.argsort(-sims[rows, kk, part], axis=2)             # order within 10
   444	        top10 = np.take_along_axis(part, ord10, axis=2)               # [Nq,K,10] sorted
   445	        del sims, part, ord10                        # free the big arrays before ensemble
   446	        top1 = top10[:, :, 0]                         # [Nq,K]
   447	        # top1 agreement: fraction of variants whose top1 == canonical-variant top1
   448	        top1_agree = (top1 == top1[:, [0]]).mean(1)   # [Nq]  (1.0 = perfectly stable)
   449	        # top10 Jaccard between canonical variant and each other, averaged
   450	        def jacc(a, b):
   451	            sa, sb = set(a.tolist()), set(b.tolist())
   452	            return len(sa & sb) / float(len(sa | sb))
   453	        jac10 = np.array([np.mean([jacc(top10[i, 0], top10[i, j]) for j in range(1, cli.K)])
   454	                          for i in range(len(hr_q))])
   455	        # ID-level top1 flip: does the IDENTITY of rank-1 change across phases?
   456	        top1_pid = g_pid[top1]                        # [Nq,K]
   457	        id_flip = np.array([len(np.unique(top1_pid[i])) for i in range(len(hr_q))])  # #distinct top1 IDs
   458	        print(f"  (B) rank volatility across the K phases:")
   459	        print(f"      top1 stays==canonical : mean={top1_agree.mean():.3f}  "
   460	              f"(1.0=stable; lower=more volatile)")
   461	        print(f"      top10 Jaccard(canon,j): mean={jac10.mean():.3f}  "
   462	              f"(1.0=identical sets)")
   463	        print(f"      #distinct rank-1 IDs over K phases: mean={id_flip.mean():.2f}  "
   464	              f"(>1 => the retrieved identity FLIPS with sampling phase)  "
   465	              f"frac queries with >=2 = {100*(id_flip>=2).mean():.1f}%")
   466	
   467	        # ---------- (D) ensemble mAP ----------
   468	        # single LR baseline
   469	        d_single = 1.0 - f_single @ gf.T
   470	        r_single = eval_map(d_single, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   471	        # phase-lattice ENSEMBLE: feature-mean (renormed) and MaxSim
   472	        f_lat_mean = f_lat.mean(1)
   473	        f_lat_mean /= (np.linalg.norm(f_lat_mean, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
   474	        d_lat_mean = 1.0 - f_lat_mean @ gf.T
   475	        r_lat_mean = eval_map(d_lat_mean, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   476	        # MaxSim: per (q,g) take the BEST sim over the K query variants
   477	        sim_lat_max = (f_lat @ gf.T).max(1)          # [Nq,Ng]
   478	        r_lat_max = eval_map(1.0 - sim_lat_max, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   479	        # ordinary-TTA ENSEMBLE (the life/death control), SAME fusions
   480	        f_tta_mean = f_tta.mean(1)
   481	        f_tta_mean /= (np.linalg.norm(f_tta_mean, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12)
   482	        r_tta_mean = eval_map(1.0 - f_tta_mean @ gf.T, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   483	        sim_tta_max = (f_tta @ gf.T).max(1)
   484	        r_tta_max = eval_map(1.0 - sim_tta_max, q_pid, q_cam, g_pid, g_cam)
   485	
   486	        print(f"  (D) ENSEMBLE mAP (K={cli.K}):")
   487	        print(f"      single bicubic LR            : mAP={r_single['mAP']:.3f}  R1={r_single['r1']:.3f}")
   488	        print(f"      phase-lattice  mean-feat     : mAP={r_lat_mean['mAP']:.3f}  R1={r_lat_mean['r1']:.3f}  "
   489	              f"(d{r_lat_mean['mAP']-r_single['mAP']:+.3f})")

   492	        print(f"      ----  LIFE/DEATH CONTROL (ordinary TTA, same K & fusion)  ----")

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2792:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:63:- **建议**: 低成本加固——把导入改成显式包名(如建个 `__init__.py` 或用 `importlib` 按文件路径加载)，或在 README/run 命令处明确"必须 `cd cargo_cvpb && python3 afd_train.py`"。**当前文档命令安全**，故仅 Medium。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓

experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

   131	    only WHICH hr pixels land on each LR sample point changes.  Axes:
   132	      - sub-pixel phase shift  (fractional HR translate before downsample)
   133	      - +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift / expand (integer LR-pixel = h/.. HR pixels)
   134	      - antialias kernel choice
   135	
   136	    variant 0 is ALWAYS the canonical deterministic bicubic LR (no perturbation) so the
   137	    single-LR baseline == variants[0].
   138	    Returns list of K PIL images (each 384x128)."""
   139	    W_hr, H_hr = hr_img.size                      # 128, 384
   140	    # how many HR pixels correspond to 1 LR pixel at this height
   141	    hr_per_lr_y = H_hr / float(h)                  # 384/h
   142	    hr_per_lr_x = W_hr / float(max(1, round(h / 3.0)))  # 128/(h/3) ~ 3
   143	    variants = [make_lr(hr_img, h, 'bicubic')]     # 0: canonical
   144	    kernels_cycle = ['bicubic', 'bilinear', 'lanczos', 'box', 'hamming']
   145	    for j in range(1, K):
   146	        # --- pick a lattice perturbation type round-robin so the K cover all axes ---
   147	        mode = j % 3
   148	        kern = kernels_cycle[j % len(kernels_cycle)]
   149	        if mode == 0:
   150	            # sub-pixel phase: fractional shift of up to +/-0.5 LR pixel (in HR px)
   151	            dx = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_x
   152	            dy = rng.uniform(-0.5, 0.5) * hr_per_lr_y
   153	            shifted = hr_img.transform(
   154	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.AFFINE, (1, 0, dx, 0, 1, dy),
   155	                resample=Image.BICUBIC)
   156	            v = make_lr(shifted, h, kern)
   157	        elif mode == 1:
   158	            # +/-1 LR-pixel bbox crop shift: crop the HR by an integer # of LR pixels on
   159	            # each side then resize back to the HR canvas (== shifting the bbox window).
   160	            sx = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_x))
   161	            sy = int(round(rng.choice([-1, 0, 1]) * hr_per_lr_y))
   162	            left = max(0, sx); upper = max(0, sy)
   163	            right = W_hr + min(0, sx); lower = H_hr + min(0, sy)
   164	            if right - left < 4 or lower - upper < 4:
   165	                left, upper, right, lower = 0, 0, W_hr, H_hr
   166	            cropped = hr_img.crop((left, upper, right, lower)).resize(
   167	                (W_hr, H_hr), Image.BICUBIC)
   168	            v = make_lr(cropped, h, kern)
   169	        else:
   170	            # bbox expand / contract by 1 LR pixel (zoom in/out a touch) + kernel swap
   171	            ez = rng.choice([-1, 1]) * 0.5 * hr_per_lr_y   # expand/contract in HR px
   172	            box = (-ez, -ez * (W_hr / H_hr), W_hr + ez, H_hr + ez * (W_hr / H_hr)) \
   173	                if ez > 0 else (abs(ez), abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr),
   174	                                W_hr - abs(ez), H_hr - abs(ez) * (W_hr / H_hr))
   175	            # PIL crop on a fractional/negative box: emulate via paste on padded canvas
   176	            l, u, r, b = box
   177	            l, u, r, b = int(round(l)), int(round(u)), int(round(r)), int(round(b))
   178	            pad = max(0, -l, -u, r - W_hr, b - H_hr) + 1
   179	            canvas = Image.new('RGB', (W_hr + 2 * pad, H_hr + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0))
   180	            canvas.paste(hr_img, (pad, pad))
